description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller 'HealthController' which provides health check endpoints for service and database connectivity. It exposes endpoints '/health', '/status', and '/health/db' to report overall service health and database reachability, including timestamps and detailed status information.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: Spring REST controller providing health check endpoints for service and database reachability.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET /health; returns overall health status with timestamp and details.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Handles GET /status; returns database connectivity status with timestamp and details.

methods.name: healthDb
methods.description: Handles GET /health/db; alias for /status to check database connectivity.
